configuration: CROWD_SERVE_MODE=curve_offset + CROWD_NOWCAST_ENABLED=true, nowcast weights on the curve_offset base 1.0 / 0 / 0 / 0 for readings 1 / 2 / 3 / 4-12 hours old (since 2026-10-14)
population: live readings 2026-09-09..10-08 (Philadelphia, Lehigh and Miami, read-only production export of 2026-10-08); the model never trained on them, but the nowcast weights were chosen on this same window, so these figures are not out-of-sample for those weights (the pre-registered October holdout scores them next)

previous_weights.what: the same readings under the nowcast weights fitted on 2026-09-01..05 (1.0 / 0.85 / 0.25 / 0), served until 2026-10-14

before.configuration: v2.6.0-starling as served before the two switches (model mode, quantile map on)

reading_one_hour_earlier.what: the scored readings whose venue had a live reading from the hour before, where the nowcast carries that reading at full weight

first_test.what: the three held-out days the switches were shipped on, under the weights fitted on 2026-09-01..05 (1.0 / 0.85 / 0.25 / 0); not re-scored with the 2026-10-14 weights
first_test.population: live readings 2026-09-06..08 (Lehigh and Miami, local 2026-09-08 export)

reproduce: from backend/scripts/ml/train/: after a read-only export (export_training_data.js), CROWD_SERVE_MODE=curve_offset CROWD_NOWCAST_ENABLED=true node bandEval.js --from=2026-09-09 --rows-out=rows.csv (the live_time_holdout section; the one-hour-earlier figures are the rows-out file filtered to ml = 1 and served_nowcast_lag_hours = 1). scored_dates is the window's first and last date. The headline figures are the served[curve_offset+nowcast] line of that command run on the 2026-10-14 code; they equal, on the 119,939 rows with ml = 1 of a rows-out file made before the change, served_nowcast_reading where served_nowcast_lag_hours = 1, else served_curve_offset. previous_weights is served_curve_offset_nowcast on that earlier file.
